description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made under Excise (Special Provisions Act, published in Gaz. Ex. No. 2073/41 of 31.05.2018 has rescinded w.e.f. 14.06.2018
categorisation: This gazette content contains a legal order made under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, specifically rescinding a previous order. It deals with regulatory matters and statutory instruments, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
